en.title: Rescuing the older dog living on edge around the younger one [Puppy Training]
en.description:
🐕 We met Bbazzi (3 months old) and Bbappi (3 years old)
(Turn on CC for Korean subtitles!)

📝 Training Content
1. The younger dog keeps bothering the older one
Bbazzi tends to pick on Bbappi because he finds the reaction entertaining.
If there are two owners, it’s best for each person to handle one dog.

2. Training dogs with opposite temperaments
Hold treats in both hands and reward the dog when they sit.
If one dog tries to get too close to the other, separate them immediately.
If they calm down and wait patiently, reward them again.
Key point: Give them extra playtime and affection when they’re alone.

See you next time 👋

snippet.title: 잘생긴 남자만 좋아한다는 환승연애 현지네 콩이 (with 메기남 강형욱)
snippet.description:
🐕 견생 5살, 콩이와 함께했습니다
(CC 버튼을 누르시면 한국어 자막이 있습니다!)

📝교육 내용
1. 식탐이 너무 많은 강아지
보호자님의 음식까지 탐내는 강아지들에게는 최대한 못 먹는 환경을 만들어 주는 것이 좋아요. 
그리고 보호자님의 음식을 강아지에게 나눠주게 되면 구분하지 못 하게 돼요. 
아무리 사랑스러운 강아지라도 보호자님의 음식은 나누어주지 않는 것이 좋아요.
*포인트 [ 아래에서 설명된 찾기 놀이를 통해서 강아지의 식탐을 조절해 줄 수 있어요. ]

2. 마약 탐지견 교육
1단계) 여러 가지 물건들을 준비하고 그 안에 간식을 숨겨요.
2단계) 숨긴 간식과 동일한 냄새를 맡게 해요.
3단계) 물건들의 냄새를 하나씩 맡게 해주고 숨겨진 간식을 찾아요.
*포인트 [ 처음에는 모든 물건 속에 간식을 숨기다가 점차 숨기는 간식의 개수를 줄여가면 좋아요. ]

3. 특정 성별을 좋아하는 강아지
사람과 마찬가지로 강아지들도 좋아하는 성향이 있어요. 
대부분의 강아지들은 부드러운 성향의 사람을 좋아하지만 
일부 강아지들은 자신을 리드해 줄 수 있는 강인한 성향에 호감을 느끼기도 해요.
*포인트 [ 콩이 같은 성격의 강아지들에게 지나친 친절은 오히려 부담감을 안겨줄 수 있어요 ]

또 봐요👋

*NOTE [ Through the "find it" game explained below, you can control the dog's appetite. ]

First step) Have various objects ready, and hide the snacks inside those objects.
Second step) Make them sniff the snack you hid in your hand.

*NOTE [ At first, you should hide the snacks in every object, but then gradually decrease the number of snacks hidden. ]

3. A dog that likes a particular gender
Like people, dogs have a specific type of people they like. 
Most dogs like people with a gentle and benign tendency 
but some dogs feel attracted towards strong personalities that could lead them.
*NOTE [ For dogs with personalities like that of Kong, being too kind can be actually overhwlemeing. ]

*Point [ They’re not doing it to tease you or out of bad intentions, haha ]

This isn’t really a problem!
Just fully enjoy bonding with your dog.

3. He gets so excited to see other people that he runs up to them.
This doesn’t really seem like a problem either!
It just means your dog is very social, like Huchu.

4. A dog that licks the owner’s face
Some people say that when a dog licks you, it means
they think you rank below them, but you always have to look at the full context of the behavior.
Basically, though, the main reason dogs lick is to show affection toward their owner.
